name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Pre-Sales Solutions Consultant | Discovery, Solution Design, Integrations & AI Workflows
summary: Customer-facing technical seller and solution builder with 15+ years in SaaS. I lead discovery with executives, translate business goals into solution designs and implementation plans, and build working integrations myself: webhooks, APIs, batch data imports, and custom JavaScript and Python code steps in Zapier, Make, and n8n, plus AI agent workflows in production.
